data.name: Iraiyan
data.gender_notes: Iraiyan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Iraiyan is a Sanskrit name derived from the term 'Iraivan', which is a reverential address to Lord Shiva. This name signifies the dwelling place of Shiva, where all spiritual and temporal needs are fulfilled. The name Iraiyan carries the meaning “Lord Shiva's abode” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Iraiyan usually hope their child will grow to embody lord shiva's abode and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that connects one with Lord Shiva and his divine abode.
data.etymology: Iraiyan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord Shiva's abode.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Iraiyan total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
